LESSON: LOVE FOR PARENTS

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2.2: Love for parents

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Love for parents. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: what the you?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Outline ways on how to  Organise the learners in pairs, show love to their parents.
2. Demonstrate ways through which respect Learners draw and colour can be accorded to parents.
3. Appreciate the role of parents in their day to day life.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Outline ways on how to  Organise the learners in pairs, show love to their parents.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to outline ways on how to  Organise the learners in pairs, show love to their parents. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Demonstrate ways through which respect Learners draw and colour can be accorded to parents.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate ways through which respect Learners draw and colour can be accorded to parents. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Appreciate the role of parents in their day to day life.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the role of parents in their day to day life. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Love for parents.
2. Explain Love for parents to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Love for parents.
4. Show that you can: Outline ways on how to  Organise the learners in pairs, show love to their parents.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Love for parents. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: what the you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Outline ways on how to  Organise the learners in pairs, show love to their parents.
2. Demonstrate ways through which respect Learners draw and colour can be accorded to parents.
3. Appreciate the role of parents in their day to day life.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
